speaker: will_sly
text: Give me the ground, Master Shakespeare, and I'll give you the fight. Words are for after. Tybalt says little and means it. I like him. He is tomorrow's man, not this morning's speech.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: He steps in under the arm. Sam, stand off the measure. This is a street, not a lesson you take on the ribs.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I am off it. I can see his feet from here. I do not need to be the man he steps under.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tomorrow he is Tybalt, Will, and the yard has to believe the steel. Today we mark the distance and we do not mark a boy. Errors is at two. I am not spending a death before I have been an old father.

speaker: john_sincler
text: While you are marking distances, write me a starved apothecary, Will, and save the company twopence in padding. My collar-bones play the part before I open my mouth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The twopence stays in the company's pocket, John. You are already the man. I am not sewing a belly onto you for one scene, and I am not paying a padding that your bones have made unnecessary.

speaker: john_sincler
text: Then I will eat my dinner and remain a disappointment to the tailor. The collar-bones thank you. The tailor may send his bill to someone fatter.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: Turn, Sam. The hook is where your hand does not go. Hold still, or I will pin the hook to you and not to the cloth.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I cannot reach it. That is why I am standing like a post. Is it the same fastening Nick uses, or is his his own?

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: His is his own, and it is not this hook. This is the back of your collar, which you will not discuss by twisting. There. It sits.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave Nick's to tomorrow, Edith. I am not having two stories about one buckle. Sam is mended. The other hand has not happened.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And when you are done with hooks, Will, the five words. I said them in the yard coming up. They die too fast. A man should have somewhere to put his hands while he goes.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not this morning, Dick. I have not answered. The vault is tomorrow's yard. I will not choose a death in a tiring-house with Egeon still to play.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Richard had a prison, a groom and four murderers. I have a cup, and a kiss, and then you shut the door on me. Ten lines would be a death. Five is an exit.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard you. I have not said yes, and I have not said no. Tonight, if you are still awake, you may ask the house. You may not ask the rehearsal. The rehearsal has a fight and a starved man and a hook, and it is full.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The voice holds if he is not startled. John's order still stands. I am not inventing a rescue for a question you have not answered.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I'll hold my tongue until the candles are out. Do not think I have agreed to five. I will still want the longer death when the house is quiet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I don't think you have agreed. Wanting it is not the same as having it. Go and be Romeo somewhere I am not yet Egeon.

speaker: will_sly
text: The ground is enough for today. Tomorrow I will mean it. Phillips has the distance. I will not add a speech to a thrust.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: The hook will hold if he does not dance in it. Payment for this is the company's, and it is not a new bill. I have not made you a prince this morning. I have closed a collar.

speaker: john_sincler
text: And I have saved you twopence by remaining as God made me. I call that a good morning's work, and I am going to eat.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I can reach the front of it. I will not reach the back. Mistress Kettlewood has the back. That is the division.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the division stands. Sly, the ground. John, no padding. Edith, his hook and not Nick's. Dick, tonight, and not before. I am for dinner, and then an old father, and then whatever you still want when you cannot sleep.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Tonight is his to ask and yours to shut. The chalk stays where I put it. I am not rehearsing a rescue.

speaker: edith_kettlewood
text: The hook is shut. I am not staying to hear a death argued in a tiring-house.
